args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter (Brightline Freight, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026"): this week's issue covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to the full article at blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain.
- Article: temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilots cut claims by a quarter.
